limitations: Application supplies/retains a server/principal-appropriate immutable command catalogue while each API call runs. The call does not retain it after return. Automatic metadata fetch/cache replacement and server-assisted exotic extraction are not implemented by this adapter.

Metadata preflight performs bounded synchronous CPU work, not an interruptible task. Argument/span/output checks, command hash/keyword scans and CRC are actual costs; original entry time covers them before native admission. Typed metadata refusals leave client admission counters unchanged. Explicit keyless slot policy never substitutes for unknown/incomplete metadata.

No extra command copy, heap allocation, catalogue ref, worker, timer or runtime is added. Warm admission still uses existing aligned operation/route storage and four caller allocation blocks; cold queued copies/native independent physical duties remain. This is not a zero-overhead CPU claim.

Performance compares identical valid warm literal-peer GET traces, one caller, pipeline1/32 and affinity0/1, same payload/native pools/workers/queues/Futures. Explicit mode0 omits metadata. Mode1 manually evaluates then calls, starting its Call deadline afterward; mode2 validates catalogue/output aliases and includes evaluation in its entry budget. Relative budget judgments apply only to non-expiring valid traces, not arbitrary failure/deadline semantics.

Unpinned serial closed-loop samples report caller-observed FIFO completion including admission/queue/validation/head-of-line. Setup/bootstrap/catalogue/sample storage excluded; first-window costs remain. Noise/resolution failures remain unqualified without retry for green. This is not fixed-arrival/mixed-load/contention/native Linux/upstream/TLS/CPU/RSS/72h acceptance.

Owned Redis8.0.5 real matrix is plaintext through numeric/DNS/prepared connections with identity-verified pools. It obtains actual authorized COMMAND INFO before INCR/GET routing, refuses cross-slot/keyless/incomplete inputs locally, and counts32 INCR executions per case. Original-seed policy denial is fault injection, not server-process death or replica failover.
Full automatic command metadata/fallback, replicas, synchronous Cluster facade and complete four-library production/performance qualification remain open.
